concerns.text: The specification restricts data ingestion to a single canonical source (Materials Project) and explicitly descopes AFLOW and the TMD supplementary dataset, whereas the original idea listed all three sources as part of the data acquisition plan. Dropping these sources reduces the chemical diversity intended for the study and constitutes an under‑reach relative to the idea.

The spec adds hard runtime and memory limits (inference < 100 ms per material, peak RAM ≤ 7 GB) that were not mentioned in the idea. These engineering constraints introduce additional work not required to answer the research question and therefore represent an over‑reach.

A composition‑only baseline (e.g., linear regression on Magpie features) with a ≥ 10 % relative MAPE reduction requirement is introduced, but the original idea never required a baseline comparison. This adds a new evaluation task beyond the scope of the stated research question.
